references.text: Moses says that he is 120 years old and can no longer go out and come in, and that the Lord has said he shall not cross over the Jordan.
The Lord commands Moses to go up to Mount Pisgah and look out over the land, but he is not allowed to cross over the Jordan.
The Lord tells Moses that he will die on the mountain and be gathered to his people, because he will not lead the people into the promised land.
Moses sees the land from Mount Nebo, but the Lord says he shall not go there. Moses dies in the land of Moab.
The Lord was also angry with Moses for the sake of the people and said that he should not enter the land, but Joshua would lead the people in.
After Moses' death, the Lord commands Joshua to cross over the Jordan with all the people into the land He gives them.
Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground, just as Moses had predicted they would do.
Moses emphasizes that the good land they are about to take possession of is not given to them because of their righteousness.
